tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, table stripes, code blocks, input fills.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus and dialogs. In light, separate from surface with a line, not a shadow.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers and card borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders (3:1 against surface in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-sunken and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata and placeholders, on any surface.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: BoromTech Orange, the identity color. Fills only: primary buttons, active tabs, highlights, illustration blocks. Never as text on white (3.2:1).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill. Dark ink, never white: white on brand fails at 3.2:1, ink passes at 5.4:1.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Orange as text: links, inline emphasis, selected labels. On the surfaces and brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind brand-strong text: selected rows, info callouts.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The secondary identity color, a deep blue-ink. Hero bands, footers, the dark half of illustrations. Text on it is night-ink.

tokens.name: night-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a night fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Passed, paid, online. As text on the surfaces.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Due soon, needs attention. As text on the surfaces.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, overdue, destructive actions. As text on the surfaces.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links. An alias of brand-strong.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px ring with a 2px surface gap.

families.display: "Bricolage Grotesque", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans Thai", "IBM Plex Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque from Google Fonts. Latin headlines only; Thai falls back to IBM Plex Sans Thai.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Ship the work, not the meeting.
styles.usage: Marketing heroes and the one headline per page.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans Thai covers Thai and Latin in one family.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: งานที่รอตรวจ · Awaiting review

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We split every client project into small, checkable tasks.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: IDs, versions, code and tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, list-row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, form field gaps, page gutter minimum.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero and band padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, code chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, image frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and avatar rings only.
